topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range reduces antenna gain, increasing path loss and interference, thus impacting link budget calculations. Adaptive power control and optimized beamformer design can mitigate these effects by managing available capacity and prioritizing traffic.
reference_context: SatCom systems use beamforming to manage capacity and prioritize traffic, with techniques like adaptive power control and QoS-OSPF to ensure reliable links.
